evidence_quotes.O: It has bass that really reaches down when the music calls for it without becoming boomy or unnatural.
evidence_quotes.C: Note that during listening sessions I compared the MartinLogan 4's with my current Yamaha HTIB system
evidence_quotes.E: I have listened to them for up to two hours at a time with no sign of "listener fatigue"
evidence_quotes.A: I would suggest reading reviews for the Denon C700 here and on headfi to aid in your decision.
evidence_quotes.N: for me at least - the frustration of trying to find specific frequencies on the AM or FM dial using the analog tuner outweigh any possible advantages
